source_integrity: Official FSSAI manuals index and Gazette lists verified; direct original 2026 May and September Gazette PDFs not retrieved; publication / future commencement separately checked against secondary transcriptions. No legal opinion or signed lab scope.

analysis_method_groups.laboratory_route: Trace-element method to be confirmed against the exact sample matrix; FSSAI Metals and Minerals manual includes ICP-MS/ICP-OES methods.
analysis_method_groups.critical_analytical_request: Document elemental target, metal/speciation form if relevant, instrument and digestion method, batch blank/spike recovery, validated LOQ and results in the legal wet/dry/dehydrated basis.

analysis_method_groups.laboratory_route: Consult current FSSAI Mycotoxins manual and verify method for the exact toxin and matrix; total and individual aflatoxin results differ.
analysis_method_groups.critical_analytical_request: Specify toxin(s), chromatographic or validated alternative method, sample homogenisation, method recovery, LOD/LOQ, certified standards and moisture/fat matrix basis.

analysis_method_groups.laboratory_route: Review FSSAI pesticides residue manual, commodity/pesticide-specific MRL and method scope; never use a commodity-agnostic pass.
analysis_method_groups.critical_analytical_request: Identify particular pesticide active ingredient(s), metabolites or residue definition, commodity, extraction and GC-MS/LC-MS method, per-analyte LOQ, matrix recovery and test reports.

analysis_method_groups.laboratory_route: Consult FSSAI Antibiotics and Hormones Residues manual; confirm substance, species/source, MRL and laboratory method where the finished article permits that application.
analysis_method_groups.critical_analytical_request: Get actual substance/compound, biological source, veterinary exposure, specific residue target and associated metabolites, matrix validation, detection limits and COA.

analysis_method_groups.laboratory_route: 'Residues' is not a single analytically identified substance; first establish whether pesticide, process residue, veterinary drug or other legal class.
analysis_method_groups.critical_analytical_request: Obtain exact residue chemical identity, source, commodity, legal row, compound-specific method and laboratory accreditation scope before requesting a regulatory number.

legislation_commencements.notification: FSS (Contaminants, Toxins and Residues) Amendment Regulations, 2026
legislation_commencements.disposition: Do not import future contaminants thresholds or commodity expansion to the current 35 case decisions.

legislation_commencements.notification: FSS (Laboratory and Sample Analysis) Amendment Regulations, 2026
legislation_commencements.affected_area: Regulatory testing methods, signed report forms and reporting deadlines
legislation_commencements.disposition: Plan for 14-day regulatory sample reports and 5-day import samples, plus method priority and updated forms, subject to the primary gazette verification; do not apply those new legal obligations early to routine internal QA testing.

quality_gates.title: Updated official manuals for cereals and dairy
quality_gates.detail: FSSAI official methods index lists revised cereal and dairy 2nd-edition manuals uploaded on 25 May 2026. Check specific method revision and whether it covers the chosen finished matrix.

quality_gates.title: 2027 laboratory regulation is future-effective
quality_gates.detail: September 2026 laboratory rule reportedly starts 1 April 2027. Fourteen-day statutory food analyst/referral and five-day import laboratory timelines cannot be imposed as present October 2026 rules, nor as blanket deadlines on private QA.

quality_gates.title: Original 2026 laboratory Gazette requires direct inspection
quality_gates.detail: Government page confirms September 2026 final amendment publication. Exact gazette text and commencement were inspected only via secondary transcription; direct eGazette PDF text not independently rendered. Regulatory counsel must verify before final sign-off.

quality_gates.title: Analytical method does not prove legal article match
quality_gates.detail: Even a laboratory-tested value with an accredited method cannot establish the legal applicability of an unapproved CTR article or limit.

quality_gates.title: No actual original lab reports obtained
quality_gates.detail: All 35 entries lack verified actual commercial sample documents in this research dataset; prefilled checklists are not sample collection or compliance evidence.
